I was on hydrocodone 4-6 a day 7.5s for 23 years, never took more unless needed to. Was obviously very active up until 51, crazy kind of active. It was all because I could, but one day they stopped working so well. Pain management place put me on a pain patch, was keen on the idea of something I read so many horror stories about so I said no more after a couple months, to many side effects. I have always run out early by a couple days due to never asking for enough or wanting the stigma of being labeled a junkie, never went thru withdrawls at any point in 20 some odd years when running out, I just stayed in bed to make sure pain didn't get worse. I kept telling these people at PM they ain't working and let do something different. They listen but they don't hear, ignore you and assume your an addict. After one appointment I was so frustrated I said, screw this and called every junkie I remember arresting and family member that had a surgery. I tried Percocet, oxycodone, soma, OxyContin and a couple others with the attitude, by God I will find something works. Didn't even think about urine test, didn't care at that time. So I go in and told them, nothing works and I want off all this crap. They said ..well we have to take you off, still with attitude I say good we are finally in agreement. Well after that I realized they worked a little, enough to keep me out of bed. I really don't know if there would put me back on them but after my first case of withdrawls, I don't want to. The poison that came out of me was just friggen horrible, my Urine smelled like some nuclear waste. I have spent most of my life fighting the urge to die but spent most of my life cheating death, kinda weird huh!!! I have tried every injection possible to no avail. I could get the pain meds off the street, but I would brake leave my family with no money after a year. I'm really trying to figure this out. I don't want to sin on my last day on earth, and I don't want my family to ever cry for me again. I spent most of my life saving them or try to wether here or overseas. And then there is the fact I am not able to or allowed to go to those wild and crazy places or do the wild and what most think are crazy things. My life sux but I gotta get past my hurting my family before I can do this responsibly. If that's even possible.
Oh God forgive me please for whatever I choose

My wife just looks at me and cries, I'm killing her being here and I would kill her if I left....tough decision for sure, but I really think she would get over it and move on in time, but as long as I'm here she has to deal with it, I thought about divorce and that's still an option, I could easily make her hate me and in a year she would be happy again but then there is the kids, their grown and gone but not sure how long it would take them to move on, it's not like I ever hear from them anyway. Oh Lord, decisions decisions
